description: Close a session when its run of calls is done, once: what you drew counts as spent, and returned says how much of the maximum went back to today's cap. Close as soon as you are done rather than letting it lapse, so the rest of the budget is free for other purchases at once. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: close_spend_session
